summary: Beyond objective rules, maintainers subjectively review modules for clarity, security, maintainability, user experience, error messages and defaults, with no exact acceptance standard.
questions: How do maintainers decide whether to accept my module?
What do reviewers look at beyond the formal requirements?

answer_card.title: Subjective review of modules
answer_card.answer_md: Maintainers review whether code is clear, concise, secure and maintainable, and whether it offers good UX, helpful error messages and reasonable defaults. There's no exact standard; following the module development tips improves your chances.
